thread_title: S. leucophylla RED 'White Lips' Franklin Co, FL
breadcrumb: S. leucophylla RED 'White Lips' Franklin Co, FL

posts.body_html:
Another plant that I have never seen anywhere: a red bodied leucophylla with contrasting white lips! Pretty darn neat! It'll be interesting to see how the fall traps develop on this clone.

It's not exactly a vigorous individual, and I have no idea how to recreate it, this is one out of many hundreds of plants, and there isn't anything else like it....so far! I wonder what would happen if you crossed an ornata black lips with this white lipped leuco clone?

S. leucophylla RED 'White Lips' Franklin Co, FL...I feel like Stewie and Donnie Schnell should have come up with a latin name for red leucos while they were at it, like S. leucophylla var. rubra, would have made the name of this clone sound more official, haha!
Anyhow, photos taken 5/2/17:

If you're looking for back-bone genetics for future hybrids, I believe this plant has the genetics to unlock color combinations never seen before! Imagine a black bodied, white lipped hybrid....who knows what can be done with this plant! It bloomed for the very first time this year, and being distracted by other flowers, I totally dropped the ball and didn't make any crosses with it Well, hopefully one of you guys in the future (once I get this darn thing propagated) might go back to this thread, review this post and come up with something extraordinary.
